C-40.IntentSummary: 2.3.1 scope of C-40 per the approved spec and the approved mockups (scratch copy given to the agent). ZCode agent without shell; the orchestrator runs gates, failing-first proofs and commits.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Spec goals in scope met; unit + e2e tests incl. corner cases; all strings in 10 locales (.json + .min.json).

T-002.Title: Title bar trim + document info popover + Win/Linux «?» (R-2a, R-3 popover, R-1 entry point)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Matches the approved canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/QmV47yCqXKzjkroruTrTLd (option A, user 2026-10-15 «все согласен»): left = sidebar toggle; centre = file name with the unsaved dot and a chevron; right = theme (Auto/Light/Dark) and Share. The Files and TOC buttons, the breadcrumb path and the word count leave the title bar. Windows/Linux keep the custom-titlebar menu and caption buttons and gain a «?» button that opens the Mark Guide (mt::open-guide).

Clicking the file name opens a popover: name, folder (~-abbreviated), size, modified (relative), words / characters / lines / reading time (selection-aware like the old counter), buttons Rename…, Show in Finder (Explorer / file manager per OS), Copy path. Esc and outside click close it; untitled documents show stats and Rename only. Rename keeps the old click-to-rename path.
Title-bar icons use the redrawn set from the canvas Icons board (16 px grid, 1.4 stroke) — shared icon module so N4 d reuses it.

Unit tests per OS (isOsx true/false): exact button set, «?» only off macOS, popover contents/actions/close; e2e chromium + webkit: popover opens from the title, stats match the document, no word count in the title bar.

A slim rail right of the text column (canvas style: uppercase «On this page» header, h1–h3, current section bold with a marker tick, deeper levels indented), highlighting the section in view while scrolling and smooth-jumping on click. Shown for documents with at least 3 headings; hidden when the editor area is narrower than 1000 px (stays when the sidebar is open if it fits); not in source mode, split or diff.

View › Outline toggles it (persisted preference, default on); ⌘T (Ctrl+T) opens a heading jump list; the sidebar TOC panel and the title-bar TOC button are retired in favour of the rail (the sidebar keeps Files and Opened files).

Unit tests for heading extraction, current-section tracking and the width/heading-count gates; e2e chromium + webkit: rail visible on a long doc, current item follows scroll, click jumps, hidden below 1000 px, toggle persists.

T-004.Title: Status bar + document tools in menus (R-3 status bar, R-2 option A)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Optional 24 px status bar: lines · words · characters · reading time (selection-aware) on the left, document type on the right. Preference statusBarVisibility: default off on macOS, on on Windows/Linux; toggles in View › Status Bar and Settings › Appearance › Window and panels; all 10 locales.

Option A: no document tools in the title bar. Lock = the existing per-tab read-only mode (tab.previewMode): View › Lock Document (and the tab context menu and palette) toggles it, the tab shows a lock badge, editing is blocked while locked. Split view and Copy as Markdown / HTML / Structured text stay reachable from View/Edit menus, palette and the tab context menu (add what is missing).
Native menu items match renderer commands (menu-consistency green); unit + e2e chromium + webkit for the status bar counts and toggles, lock badge and edit blocking.

T-005.Title: View-menu checkmarks follow the real state (F-MENU-WIRE-TAURI follow-up, release-review gap)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Backend: one command mt_menu_set_checked(id, checked) finds a CheckMenuItem RECURSIVELY through submenus (tauri 2 Menu::get is top-level-only — the reason mt_update_sidebar_menu never worked) and is allow-listed to the four view ids (view.toggle-sidebar, view.toggle-tabbar, view.outline, view.status-bar); benign misses Ok(false), real failures Err; log anchors BLOCK_MENU_CHECK_SYNCED / BLOCK_MENU_CHECK_NOT_FOUND; mt_update_sidebar_menu reuses the walker.

Renderer (editor window only): util/menuChecks.js pushes the effective state of all four after preferences/layout hydrate at boot (syncViewMenuChecks from APPLY_BOOTSTRAP_EDITOR) and one push per later change from any toggle surface (watchViewMenuChecks in app.vue); statusBarVisibility keeps its per-OS default with the stored user value winning; failures swallowed with a warn, never break boot.

Tests: cargo unit tests for the allow-list/taxonomy parity; renderer unit tests for boot push, per-flip push, per-OS default, rejection; e2e chromium + webkit recording mt_menu_set_checked through the tauri-shim (default returns false so other specs are unaffected).

T-005.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/menu-checks) implemented 2026-10-16; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). Design notes: the recursive walker lives in m009_menu (find_check_item_recursive + set_app_menu_check, thin around the pure SYNCABLE_CHECK_IDS allow-list — a live menu needs a real runtime, so cargo tests pin the allow-list policy, its taxonomy parity and that build_native_menu builds all four ids via CheckMenuItemBuilder via a source self-check); the v1 mt_update_sidebar_menu shim reuses set_app_menu_check and stays best-effort. Renderer: boot full push from APPLY_BOOTSTRAP_EDITOR (after SET_LAYOUT — load-bearing because a hydrated value equalling the store default fires no watcher while the native items carry fixed build-time defaults: Toggle Tab Bar is built checked, the store default is false) + one watcher per item installed in app.vue setup (editor window only). The command registers in main.rs generate_handler! next to mt_update_line_ending_menu; not added to the M-013-A tauri.v2.json fixture (v1-compat/menu-handler family is intentionally outside REGISTERED_COMMANDS) and needs no capabilities entry (custom app commands are not ACL-listed; capabilities/default.json grants plugin permissions only). playwright.config.ts gains the webkit-menu-checks project so the spec gates in both engines; tauri-shim default for mt_menu_set_checked returns false.
T-005.ReviewEvidence: Orchestrator review 2026-10-16: cargo test 407 passed (m009 25); vitest 278 files / 3802 passed; grace lint 0 errors (MODULE_MAP fix in menu-checks.test.js); Playwright chromium + webkit 370/370 (8 timed out under a machine load of ~10–12 and passed on --last-failed rerun). Red on main: menu-checks.test.js fails to load; view-menu-checks.spec 2/2 fail. Live macOS check of the checkmarks pending the release smoke.

M-057 had no V-M-057. CI now runs the webkit-titlebar project.
T-002.Gates: npm test 3696 passed (int/c40); e2e 320 passed chromium + webkit; titleBar-* and titlebar-doc-info green; WebKit screenshots: trimmed bar, popover light/dark.

T-003.ReviewFixes: Component test mounted the rail one div too deep (attachTo wrapper), so the column was never found; the sidebar drag bar was wired without a null check (unhandled error when hidden at mount); the e2e scroll-tracking fixture merged its filler lines into one paragraph, so the "current section" assertions could never hold — fixed, 2× green in both engines. Rail is visible from ~1072 px at the default column (1000 px hard floor + no-overlap rule) — accepted. Scenario renumbered to 54 (T-002 took 53). CI runs webkit-outline.
